Asset: Forklift FL-07 (Toyota 8FG)  
Severity: LOW  
Description: Forklift would not start on first key turn. Cold start issue suspected. Battery voltage checked at 12.1V, within spec, but starter motor sluggish. No warning lights on dash.  
Resolution: Replaced starter motor solenoid (part no. 28510-0L010). Tested over 10 start cycles, all successful. Unit returned to service.  
Technician: P. D. Singh  
Supervisor Initial: JO 05/01/23

Site: Lutterworth Workshop  
Asset: Compressor CP-2 (Atlas Copco GA30)  
Severity: MED  
Description: Oil leak detected under compressor during routine morning inspection. Leak traced to oil separator housing gasket. Approximately 0.5L of oil lost. Compressor had been running with reduced pressure output for unknown period.  
Resolution: Replaced gasket and oil separator element. Topped up oil to correct level. Ran unit for 30 minutes under load; no further leaks observed. Logged oil consumption for next two weeks.  
Technician: M. T. Bell  
Supervisor Initial: JO 10/01/23

Description: Belt tracking off centre, rubbing against guard rail causing excessive wear on edge. Operator reported squealing noise at 14:30. Belt had been adjusted three times in previous month.  
Resolution: Realigned drive and idler rollers. Replaced worn edge strip. Set belt tension per manual (Section 4.2). Noted that guard rail clearance is at minimum spec; recommended replacement of guard in Q2 maintenance plan.  
Technician: A. R. Whitfield  
Supervisor Initial: JO 14/01/23

Asset: Generator GEN-1 (Caterpillar 3306)

Resolution: Topped up coolant, replaced radiator hose and clamps. Pressure tested cooling system for 1 hour, no leaks. Ran generator under 75% load for 2 hours. Passed load test. Added coolant level check to weekly station checklist.  
Technician: A. R. Whitfield  
Supervisor Initial: JO 11/02/23

Site: Lutterworth Workshop  
Asset: Band Saw BS-2  
Severity: LOW  
Description: Blade snapped during cut on 50mm steel bar. No injury. Blade had been in service for estimated 40 hours; expected life is 60 hours. Break occurred at weld joint.  
Resolution: Replaced blade. Inspected wheel alignment; found slight misalignment on drive wheel. Adjusted alignment. Test cut performed, no issues.  
Technician: M. T. Bell  
Supervisor Initial: JO 15/02/23
ENTRY 009 – 21/02/2023
Site: Leicester Depot
Asset: Forklift FL-3 (Toyota 8FGU25)
Severity: MED
Description: Forklift lost hydraulic pressure while moving pallet of castings. Load was lowered manually using emergency descent valve. No dropped load. Inspection found cracked hydraulic hose on lift cylinder. Hose showed external abrasion at point where it rubbed against chassis bracket. Bracket had sharp edge. 
Resolution: Replaced hose, dressed bracket edge with grinder to remove burr, painted touched-up area. Pressure tested system to 180 bar, no leaks. Checked all other hose routes on same machine for chafing; found one other hose with minor wear, replaced as precaution. Added hose-routing check to quarterly service schedule for all forklifts at Leicester.
Technician: P. D. Singh
Supervisor Initial: JO 23/02/23

Site: Market Harborough Pump Station
Asset: Pump P-2 (Grundfos CR 64-3)
Severity: LOW
Description: Grease nipple on motor bearing was blocked. Grease gun would not take. Bearing had been greased at last service; blockage likely due to old grease that had hardened. Motor temperature was normal.
Resolution: Removed nipple, cleaned passage, fitted new nipple. Greased bearing per schedule. No further issue. Noted on P-2 service record that grease type will be changed to synthetic grade at next service to reduce hardening.
Technician: M. T. Bell
Supervisor Initial: JO 01/03/23

Site: Lutterworth Workshop
Asset: Compressor COM-1 (Ingersoll Rand)
Severity: MED
Description: Compressor failed to reach cut-out pressure. Ran continuously, pressure stayed at 6.5 bar instead of 8.0 bar. Suspected leaking check valve or unloader fault. Workshop was in use; compressor had been running for over 2 hours before noticed.
Resolution: Found unloader valve sticking open. Stripped, cleaned, replaced seat. Tested compressor through 3 full cycles, reached 8.0 bar and cut out correctly. Checked for other leaks with ultrasonic detector; none found. Logged on compressor maintenance sheet.
Technician: A. R. Whitfield
Supervisor Initial: JO 10/03/23

Site: Leicester Depot
Asset: Overhead Crane OC-1 (2 ton)
Severity: CRIT
Description: Crane pendant control cable caught on a stillage during lift. Operator stopped lift, cable was pulled from pendant. No load dropped. Cable had been routed through a guide that had worked loose. Guide bolt was missing; likely had worked out over time. 
Resolution: Fitted new guide bolt with threadlock, re-routed cable, tested all pendant functions including emergency stop. Load tested to 2.2 ton. Added guide bolt check to monthly crane inspection. Missing bolt was not found; assumed dropped and swept up.
Technician: P. D. Singh
Supervisor Initial: JO 16/03/23

Site: Market Harborough Pump Station
Asset: Pump P-1 (Grundfos CR 64-3)
Severity: MED
Description: Pump vibration higher than normal during routine round. Vibration reading 7.1 mm/s on motor drive end; normal is below 4.5 mm/s. No unusual noise. Pump had been running continuously for several days due to high demand.
Resolution: Checked coupling alignment; found 0.4 mm offset. Realigned coupling, re-torqued bolts. Vibration reading after alignment 3.9 mm/s. Monitored for next hour, stable. Coupling will be replaced at next planned shutdown as precaution.
Technician: A. R. Whitfield
Supervisor Initial: JO 24/03/23

Site: Lutterworth Workshop
Asset: Milling Machine MM-1 (Bridgeport)

Description: Coolant pump not delivering coolant to cutter. Pump motor running but no flow. Filter strainer was blocked with swarf and grinding dust. Machine had been used for heavy roughing cuts the previous day.
Resolution: Cleaned strainer, flushed coolant tank, replaced coolant with fresh mix. Tested pump, flow restored. Added strainer clean to weekly workshop checklist. All machines to have strainer checked weekly; was previously monthly.
Technician: M. T. Bell
Supervisor Initial: JO 03/04/23

ENTRY 009 – 21/02/2023
Site: Leicester Depot
Asset: Forklift FL-3 (Toyota 8FGU25)
Severity: MED
Description: Forklift lost hydraulic pressure while moving pallet of castings. Load was lowered manually using emergency descent valve. No dropped load. Inspection found cracked hydraulic hose on lift cylinder. Hose showed external abrasion at point where it rubbed against chassis bracket. Bracket had sharp edge. 
Resolution: Replaced hose, dressed bracket edge with grinder to remove burr, painted touched-up area. Pressure tested system to 180 bar, no leaks. Checked all other hose routes on same machine for chafing; found one other hose with minor wear, replaced as precaution. Added hose-routing check to quarterly service schedule for all forklifts at Leicester.
Technician: P. D. Singh
Supervisor Initial: JO 23/02/23

---

ENTRY 010 – 28/02/2023
Site: Market Harborough Pump Station
Asset: Pump P-2 (Grundfos CR 64-3)
Severity: LOW
Description: Grease nipple on motor bearing was blocked. Grease gun would not take. Bearing had been greased at last service; blockage likely due to old grease that had hardened. Motor temperature was normal.
Resolution: Removed nipple, cleaned passage, fitted new nipple. Greased bearing per schedule. No further issue. Noted on P-2 service record that grease type will be changed to synthetic grade at next service to reduce hardening.
Technician: M. T. Bell
Supervisor Initial: JO 01/03/23

ENTRY 011 – 08/03/2023
Site: Lutterworth Workshop
Asset: Compressor COM-1 (Ingersoll Rand)
Severity: MED
Description: Compressor failed to reach cut-out pressure. Ran continuously, pressure stayed at 6.5 bar instead of 8.0 bar. Suspected leaking check valve or unloader fault. Workshop was in use; compressor had been running for over 2 hours before noticed.
Resolution: Found unloader valve sticking open. Stripped, cleaned, replaced seat. Tested compressor through 3 full cycles, reached 8.0 bar and cut out correctly. Checked for other leaks with ultrasonic detector; none found. Logged on compressor maintenance sheet.
Technician: A. R. Whitfield
Supervisor Initial: JO 10/03/23

---

ENTRY 012 – 15/03/2023
Site: Leicester Depot
Asset: Overhead Crane OC-1 (2 ton)
Severity: CRIT
Description: Crane pendant control cable caught on a stillage during lift. Operator stopped lift, cable was pulled from pendant. No load dropped. Cable had been routed through a guide that had worked loose. Guide bolt was missing; likely had worked out over time. 
Resolution: Fitted new guide bolt with threadlock, re-routed cable, tested all pendant functions including emergency stop. Load tested to 2.2 ton. Added guide bolt check to monthly crane inspection. Missing bolt was not found; assumed dropped and swept up.
Technician: P. D. Singh
Supervisor Initial: JO 16/03/23

Site: Market Harborough Pump Station
Asset: Pump P-1 (Grundfos CR 64-3)
Severity: MED
Description: Pump vibration higher than normal during routine round. Vibration reading 7.1 mm/s on motor drive end; normal is below 4.5 mm/s. No unusual noise. Pump had been running continuously for several days due to high demand.
Resolution: Checked coupling alignment; found 0.4 mm offset. Realigned coupling, re-torqued bolts. Vibration reading after alignment 3.9 mm/s. Monitored for next hour, stable. Coupling will be replaced at next planned shutdown as precaution.
Technician: A. R. Whitfield
Supervisor Initial: JO 24/03/23

Site: Lutterworth Workshop
Asset: Milling Machine MM-1 (Bridgeport)
Severity: LOW
Description: Coolant pump not delivering coolant to cutter. Pump motor running but no flow. Filter strainer was blocked with swarf and grinding dust. Machine had been used for heavy roughing cuts the previous day.
Resolution: Cleaned strainer, flushed coolant tank, replaced coolant with fresh mix. Tested pump, flow restored. Added strainer clean to weekly workshop checklist. All machines to have strainer checked weekly; was previously monthly.
Technician: M. T. Bell
Supervisor Initial: JO 03/04/23
